about.label: About Us
about.headline: Getting to Know LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi
about.history_narration: LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi is a banking service unit operating within SMKN 1 Bantul. Starting from an initiative to provide real practical facilities for students, we have now grown into a trusted transaction service center for the entire school community.

timeline.title: Establishment
timeline.description: Began operations in April 2008 with an initial capital of IDR 2,000,000.

timeline.title: Transformation
timeline.description: Developed into a more modern Sharia Banking Laboratory.

timeline.title: Teaching Factory
timeline.description: Functions as a Teaching Factory, practical laboratory, and a mini bank serving customers.

items.q: What is LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi?
items.a: LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi is a sharia mini bank at SMKN 1 Bantul that functions as a student practice facility as well as a school banking service provider.

items.q: What is meant by Wadiah savings?
items.a: Wadiah is pure entrustment. In our mini bank, this means your savings are safe, no interest, and no monthly admin fee deductions.
Our services are open to all students, teachers, and employees within SMKN 1 Bantul.
Our tellers are ready to serve you on school days, especially during student break hours.
